purpose: Design-space benchmark for a robotic tactile cell. All numerical limits are proposed engineering targets, not verified performance or material measurements.

dataset_splits.warning: Do not split neighboring samples of a single contact trajectory randomly among subsets.

metrics.force_rmse_N: calibrated full test set, report per load axis and condition
metrics.false_positive_rate: no-contact samples across temperature and base-strain conditions
metrics.worst_case_channel_snr_dB: measured or separately labeled synthetic signal/noise
metrics.residual_deflection_mm_after_5s: measured or viscoelastic simulation with calibration status
metrics.cross_axis_error: cross-talk matrix and inverse decoder validation
metrics.identifiability: singular values of noise-whitened force-position Jacobian with measurement covariance
metrics.mesh_convergence: separately report change in displacement and max stress on refinement
metrics.bill_of_materials: priced hardware + fabrication consumables + labor separately
metrics.data_provenance: simulation/analytic/measurement, model hash and calibration specimen

fidelity_tiers.T0: synthetic fast-screen only; no physical validation
fidelity_tiers.T1: connected mechanical FEM and approximate electronics; require mesh sensitivity report
fidelity_tiers.T2: nonlinear material/contact model plus independent synthetic held-out tests
fidelity_tiers.T3: instrumented hardware validation with calibration data and uncertainty

promotion_policy.note: An unmeasured, synthetic feasible candidate is never labeled hardware-validated.
